label: rem:observable-mtc-remark
title: Semisimplicity, simple objects and modularity at $q = \zeta_N$
html: At q = \zeta_N the representation category \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{su}_2)) is no longer semisimple; quotienting out the ideal of negligible morphisms yields the truncated category \mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{any}}(N), with finitely many simple objects \mathbf{V}_0, \mathbf{V}_1, \ldots, \mathbf{V}_{N-2} [moore-seiberg1989]. The observable modular tensor category is modular: the S-matrix S_{ij} = \mathrm{tr}(c_{\mathbf{V}_i, \mathbf{V}_j} \circ c_{\mathbf{V}_j, \mathbf{V}_i}) is non-degenerate.
